description: A script for filtering fonts.xml to include only desired font packages, used in GYP build configurations.

methods.name: SelectFont
methods.description: Determines if a font node should be kept based on package category, weight, and style.

methods.name: FilterFonts
methods.description: Recursively filters font nodes in the XML document based on a predicate function.

methods.name: GetContainerName
methods.description: Recursively retrieves the name of a container node of a specific type.

methods.name: DoMain
methods.description: Main function handling command-line arguments, parsing XML, filtering fonts, and outputting results.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that calls DoMain with command-line arguments.
